page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin, read as printed: "Memo-", "rabilis de", "bibone", "bistoria,". The last is doubtful. The first letter of the page is cut off and read as a likely c with [?]. The word "XXIV" reads as "XXI V" in the scan, so it is copied as printed. Printed hyphens are kept as they stand. Some letters in the text are doubtful and not marked with [?], because the scan is clear enough to read them.
